question:
What did you feel the first time you watched an anime with voices being added to your own characters??

I feel like it must have been incredibly moving. 😭
answer:
It had always been my dream to have one of my works made into an anime, so watching the whole process of my own work actually becoming an anime made me think, “If possible, I'd like to keep experiencing this feeling forever,” “I'm glad I became an author,” and “I'm glad I started writing novels.” If someone asked me to name the best day of my life, that moment would unquestionably be one of the candidates.

The timing happened to work out well, and the very first work I wrote was adapted into an anime. On top of that, the first episode was broadcast as a one-hour special.

I was allowed to listen to the audition tapes when the cast was being decided, and Yusuke Kobayashi's audition for Subaru in particular was incredible. Everyone unanimously agreed, “There's no choice but to have Yusuke Kobayashi play Natsuki Subaru.”

The argument scene with Emilia in Arc 3 was especially amazing... I was very impressed by how he portrayed Subaru's absolutely unbelievable level of scumbaggery!! I'm not insulting him! (laughs)
